title: GET /api/tenant/features
description: What the login page needs before anyone has signed in, and nothing more (decision I3). The installed components, keys and capabilities of the authorization provider are in the authenticated GET /api/me/access of contract-infra-authz. Public, through the edge.

display_name.description: The deployment's name for the login page, optional.

capabilities.description: The capabilities this member declares (capabilities.yaml). The login page degrades by them: no social_cn, no DingTalk button.
